Guided holotropic breathwork experience designed to support deep presence, emotional release, and expanded self-awareness.

About this Event

Enjoy a 90-minute guided holotropic breathwork experience designed to support deep presence, emotional release, and expanded self-awareness through conscious, rhythmic breathing.
Holotropic Breathwork is a powerful modality developed by Dr. Stanislav Grof that uses intentional, accelerated breathing combined with immersive sound and somatic guidance to access expanded states of consciousness.

Through the breath, you’ll move energy, emotions, and memories stored in the body — allowing deep healing, clarity, and transformation to unfold naturally.
This isn’t just breathwork. It’s a ceremony for the soul.
Details
• 90-minute session including opening, breathwork, and integration
• $40 per person
• $60 for two (come with a partner or friend)

🌿 What to BringYoga mat (or something comfortable to lie on)Blanket (or multiple blankets) for warmth and comfortEye mask to help you journey inwardCrystals or grounding items for added energetic supportWater bottle and an open heart

✨ What to ExpectA safely guided breathwork journey led by experienced facilitatorsReiki and energy healing support throughout the sessionA nourishing soundscape designed to help you drop in deeplyEmotional release, spiritual insights, and profound inner renewalIntegration time to ground and reflect with community
💭 FAQsWhat is Holotropic Breathwork?
It’s a transformative breathing technique that activates expanded states of awareness — helping you release emotional blockages, stress, and stored trauma in a deeply healing way.
Is it safe?
Yes. Our facilitators are trained professionals who ensure a grounded, supported, and nurturing environment. If you have significant heart conditions or are pregnant, we recommend checking with your healthcare provider first.
Do I need experience?
Not at all! This session is open to all levels. Come as you are — just be willing
